title: I Am Nan
lines: I am Nan. I am at a tan pan.
Nan and Tim sit. Pam is in a nap.

questions.listenFor: A tan pan. The first line tells you, and the second says it again.

questions.ask: Why do Nan and Tim sit down?
questions.listenFor: Pam is asleep. Listen for them connecting the nap to the stopping — that is the whole story.

questions.ask: What would you do so as not to wake someone? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea — tiptoe, whisper, go to another room.
